about: Real @arizeai/openinference-instrumentation-openai spans (JavaScript), the counterpart of ../openinference-openai with the same scenarios and responses, recorded through a scripted fetch: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK.

scenarios.chat: Non-streaming chat with a system and a user message, temperature and max_tokens set.
scenarios.chat_stream: Streaming chat with stream_options.include_usage. Unlike the Python instrumentor, the JS one records no first-token event and leaves the status unset.
scenarios.tool_call: A tool definition with tool_choice auto; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.tool_response: The follow-up: the assistant's tool call and the tool's result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.error: The provider answers 400 (model_not_found): an exception event and an ERROR status.
scenarios.embeddings: One embeddings call; the response vector is three floats.
scenarios.image_data_url: A user message with a text part and an image_url part holding a 1x1 PNG as a data URL.
scenarios.image_https_url: A user message with a text part and an image_url part holding an https URL.
scenarios.image_redacted: A user message with a text part and an image_url part holding a data URL over 32,000 characters: the instrumentor writes __REDACTED__ in the flattened message and keeps the full data URL in input.value.
scenarios.input_audio: gpt-4o-audio-preview with an input_audio part (WAV, base64). The flattened messages keep only the text part; the audio exists only in input.value.
scenarios.audio_output: gpt-4o-audio-preview answering with message.audio (base64 WAV and a transcript). The flattened output message has only its role; the audio exists only in output.value.

openinference-js-openai-4.4.1.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-19 twice in a row from the lockfile's node_modules (Node 24.2.0): byte-identical, and the earlier scenarios unchanged.
